controls.label: Shape
controls.qualification: A sphere of the published radius, lit by K2-31; the neutral gray is a display convention, not a measured colour.
controls.notes: No image or colour of K2-31 b is published: the sphere has its measured size, and the gray marks an unresolved surface. The lighting is its own star's, at the measured orbit. The gray takes the colour of k2-31's light, as its colour dataset measures it.

charts.alt: The orbits of K2-31's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-31 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

K2-31 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (91) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 50171060, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 8 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 10 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 4-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.

physical.credit: Radius from Grziwa et al. 2016 (2016AJ....152..132G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive; mass from Grziwa et al. 2016, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2016AJ....152..132G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive; orbit from Grziwa et al. 2016 (2016AJ....152..132G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive
